layout.title: How a sewage treatment plant works

shows.does: a pipe from the town ends in a big pipe mouth that pours brown sewage into the river, a rubber duck floats nearby
the river water turns brown and a brown plume drifts round the duck as it bobs along
the ground is dug, the sewer turns into the plant and a bar screen catches rags and trash
brown water runs past the screen and fills a tank, still brown
in the still tank heavy grains sink to the floor and scum floats up
the water above the solids runs on into a second tank and it is still murky
a blower pushes air down a hose and bubbles rise through the second tank, which clears
a glowing outline traces the bubbling tank
brown sludge lumps sink and pile up on the tank floor
sludge runs up a pipe to a round digester and a gas flame burns on top
the cleaner water runs out the pipe toward the river, still carrying germs
a channel of ultraviolet lamps lights up purple over the outgoing water
clear water pours from the pipe mouth, the river turns clean and the duck bobs on
clean water keeps flowing into the river

layout.why: A town's sewer ends in a pipe mouth over a river with a rubber duck floating in it; the plant is dug in the cut between town and river, so the sewage's own path (screen, settling tank, aeration tank, digester, ultraviolet channel, outfall) is the order of the story, seen in section. Each problem is a visible consequence (brown plume round the duck, brown water past the screen, murky tank, sludge on the floor), and the end returns to the pipe mouth pouring clean water past the duck.

sentences.text: If you pipe your toilets into a river, you have a sewer.
But the river turns brown around the duck.
So you dig a plant, where a screen catches trash.
But past the screen, the water stays brown.
So the tank stays still, and solids sink.
But the water above the solids stays murky.
So you blow in air, and bacteria eat waste.
But the bacteria settle as sludge on the floor.
So you pump sludge to a digester, where gas burns.
But past the digester, germs still ride out.
So ultraviolet lamps kill the germs before the outfall.
Open the outfall, and clean water reaches the duck.
Congratulations, you have built a sewage treatment plant.
